description: This file is a test script for Git, specifically testing the 'git rev-list' command with various '--ancestry-path' options and related features. It sets up commit histories, defines test functions, and verifies expected outputs for different revision range queries.

methods.name: test_merge

methods.name: test_expect_success
methods.description: Sets up a test condition and asserts success with provided commands.

methods.name: test_ancestry
